title: Delicate French Vegetable Gratin
description: A rich and savory side dish made with delicate French vegetables, perfect for special occasions.

ingredients.name: Delicate French Vegetables (Carrots, Zucchini, and Bell Peppers)

instructions: In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the sliced vegetables and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix the cream and grated cheese until smooth.
Add the cooked vegetables to the cream mixture and stir to combine.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh thyme.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional grated cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown and bubbly, about 20-25 minutes.
